title: Ivo and the Asset
author: Mara Vane
blurb: Noor Vane, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
